name: CO2 Impact
summary: UK carbon reporting software for small and mid-sized businesses: emissions from bills and uploads across Scope 1, 2 and 3, a carbon reduction plan, SECR reports and optional automated meter data.
best_for: UK small and mid-sized businesses that need a first carbon footprint, Scope 1-3 reporting or a carbon reduction plan for customers and tenders, without hiring a consultant
skip_if: you want to test the reports before committing for a year (the 7-day Basic trial has none), you need multi-country group reporting, or you already work with a sustainability consultancy that supplies its own tools
honest_knock: Every licence is a 12-month commitment, and on 9 October automated electricity and gas data was billed extra per meter per year; the redesigned pricing table of 22 October no longer shows add-on prices at all, so extra users, sites and meter feeds have to be quoted. The free trial is Basic only, for 7 days, with up to 10 entries per activity category and no reports, so you cannot test the output you are buying. We have not used CO2 Impact ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per year (£39/mo) for 1 user and 1 site
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-09 in a browser render of the pricing table on co2impact.co.uk's homepage; re-verified 2026-10-22 on the redesigned table, GBP, all prices exclude VAT) Every licence runs for 12 months: annual payment is charged upfront, monthly payment is spread over the 12-month licence. Basic is £468 a year (£39.00 a month) for 1 user and 1 operational site. Professional is £599 a year (£49.92 a month) for 3 users and 3 sites. Premium is £729 a year (£60.75 a month) for 5 users and 5 sites. Platinum is £1,199 a year (£99.92 a month) for 10 users and 10 sites. Every plan lists Scope 1, 2 and 3 (15 categories), AI support and all reporting functions; Premium and Platinum add a manufactured-goods carbon calculator and enhanced reporting. Basic can be tried free for 7 days without a card, with 1 user and 1 site, up to 10 entries per activity category and no reports during the trial. On 9 October the table also priced add-ons: an additional user at £60 a year, an additional site at £80 a year, consultancy at £75 an hour, and automated meter data per meter per year (electricity £36, £33, £30 and £24, gas £15.60, £14.40, £13.20 and £12, Basic to Platinum); the redesigned table of 22 October no longer shows those add-on prices, so ask for them before you buy. The old /pricing page with placeholder dollar plans now redirects to the homepage table.
